title: Help Me, the Japanese reissue and Marshall Sehorn's check
summary: Ridgley covered a Bill Anderson country song; Marshall Sehorn sold the soul sides to a Japanese label, paying Ridgley $200 by a bounced check; Shack Up and the New Orleans symphony strings.
